verdict.summary: Round 2 resolves both prior findings. The manifest and module documentation now accurately describe the 17-case input as a hand-written differential corpus rather than the W3C entailment-conformance suite, explicitly limit the spike's question to equivalence with the shipping six-rule materializer, and add independent required/forbidden conclusions so equality is not the sole semantic oracle. The scale label is corrected from 84 to 64 leaf classes, matching 4 x 4 x 4. The new expectations exercise each of rdfs2/3/5/7/9/11, interactions, cycles, no-op/schema-only shapes, and positive and negative outcomes; closure equality is checked on the real compiled-rule and materializer paths before timing. The experimental rules remain feature-gated and do not alter the shipping path, meta-level divergences are candidly reported outside the asserted envelope, and performance output is clearly marked non-canonical. No correctness, soundness, test-validity, or security defect remains in the diff-scoped change.
